decisions.reason: Because glazed industrial sectional doors build directly on the firm’s existing sectional door, glazing, and thermal knowledge, the firm can assimilate early results and improve the product, making a drop unlikely.
The insulated glazed variant leverages the firm’s established thermal and sectional door expertise, so absorptive capacity supports learning from early results and keeping it.
Having its own web page signals stronger integration with the firm’s existing glazed-door capabilities, and the firm’s related R&D knowledge makes it well positioned to keep and improve the product.
